patterns.meaning: If (as you say / as it seems) ~, then …

formation.example: 使わないなら・読んでしまったのなら

formation.form: Noun(×だ) + なら / Noun である + (の)なら

patterns.connection_notes: な-adj and Noun drop だ: 雨なら (NOT 雨のなら).
can_be_used_for: Reacting to info from others or the situation
Speaker's judgment / will / request / advice in the second half
patterns.exam_pinpoint: First half picks up what the OTHER person just said or what you see (その箱、使わないんですか → 使わないなら…) → なら

confusable_with.difference: たら: A happens first then B. なら: B can come before A (行くなら、切符を買っておいて).
confusable_with.how_to_choose: Second action happens BEFORE the condition → なら.

confusable_with.difference: ば is general condition; なら reacts to information.
confusable_with.how_to_choose: Reacting to someone's words → なら.

examples.japanese: その箱{はこ}、もう使{つか}わないんですか。使{つか}わないならわたしにください。
examples.english: You're not using that box anymore? If not, please give it to me.

examples.japanese: ああ、あした^は雨{あめ}か。雨{あめ}ならサイクリングに^は行{い}けそうもないね。
examples.english: Oh, rain tomorrow. If it's raining, we probably can't go cycling.
examples.note: Info from forecast → judgment. Noun + なら.

more_examples.japanese: その本{ほん}、読{よ}んでしまったのならわたしに貸{か}してくれませんか。
more_examples.english: If you've finished that book, could you lend it to me?

patterns.book_explanation: 「～という情報を受けて、…。」～ is learned from others' words or the situation; … is the speaker's judgment, will, or request.
patterns.one_line_memory_trick: なら = 'If THAT's the case (you just told me)…'

patterns.reading: ては / では / のでは

formation.form: て形 + は / 普通形 + のでは
formation.example: 行っては・建て始めるのでは

formation.form: Noun + では / Noun な + のでは

patterns.connection_notes: Verb て形 + は; い-adj ～くては; な-adj・Noun ～では; plain form + のでは.
patterns.exam_pinpoint: Second half is a BAD result (大変・困る・迷惑・だめ・きらわれる・できない) → ては / では

confusable_with.difference: たら is neutral and allows good results and requests; ては only allows bad results.
confusable_with.how_to_choose: Bad result & no request → ては.
Condition causes the bad result → ては.

common_traps: Option with a positive result is always wrong
Option with ～しよう (intention) is always wrong

examples.japanese: 山中{やまなか}さん^は手術{しゅじゅつ}したばかりだから、お見舞{みま}いに行{い}って^はかえって迷惑{めいわく}だろう。
examples.english: Yamanaka just had surgery, so visiting would only be a bother.
examples.note: Bad result 迷惑 → ては.

examples.japanese: そんな無責任{むせきにん}な態度{たいど}で^はみんなにきらわれますよ。
examples.english: With such an irresponsible attitude, everyone will dislike you.

more_examples.japanese: 今{いま}から家{いえ}を建{た}て始{はじ}めるので^は年内{ねんない}に^はでき上{あ}がらない。
more_examples.english: If you start building the house now, it won't be finished within the year.

patterns.book_explanation: 「～という事実(または仮定の状況)だと、…というよくない結果になる。」… is negative; no hope/intention/requests.
patterns.one_line_memory_trick: ては = 'if you do that… (uh oh)'

formation.form: Noun さえ + Verb ば形 / Verb ます-stem + さえ + すれば
formation.example: 漫画さえ読んでいれば・言いさえすれば

formation.form: Noun さえ + Noun なら

patterns.connection_notes: Verb: ます-stem + さえ + すれば (言いさえすれば); て形 + さえいれば.
can_be_used_for: The minimum condition needed for a result
cannot_be_used_for: 'even' meaning without ば/なら (that is plain さえ)
patterns.exam_pinpoint: Only ONE minimal condition is enough for the result (体さえ丈夫なら何でもできる) → さえ～ば

confusable_with.difference: Alone, さえ = 'even' (子どもさえ知っている).
confusable_with.how_to_choose: Followed by ば/なら → minimum condition.

confusable_with.difference: だけ = only; さえ～ば = only that is needed.

common_traps: Wrong formation: 言うさえすれば ✗ → 言いさえすれば

examples.japanese: 体{からだ}さえ丈夫{じょうぶ}ならどんなことにも挑戦{ちょうせん}できる。
examples.english: As long as I'm healthy, I can take on any challenge.

examples.japanese: 一言{ひとこと}「ごめんなさい。」と言{い}いさえすれば、相手{あいて}^は許{ゆる}してくれるだろう。
examples.english: If you just say 'I'm sorry', they'll probably forgive you.
examples.note: Verb stem + さえ + すれば.

more_examples.japanese: 太郎{たろう}^は漫画{まんが}さえ読{よ}んでいれば退屈{たいくつ}しないようだ。
more_examples.english: As long as Taro has manga to read, he never seems bored.

patterns.book_explanation: 「～が実現すれば、それだけで…が実現する。」Shows the minimum condition necessary for … .
patterns.one_line_memory_trick: さえ～ば = 'Just this one key opens the door.'

patterns.pattern: たとえ～ても… / たとえ～でも…

formation.form: たとえ + て形 + も

patterns.connection_notes: たとえ is paired with ても/でも. Often with どんなに / 何を.
patterns.exam_pinpoint: たとえ at the start → the answer must contain ても / でも

confusable_with.difference: たとえ only strengthens ても.
confusable_with.how_to_choose: たとえ requires ても, not ば/たら.

common_traps: たとえ…ば / たとえ…たら ✗

examples.japanese: たとえ周{まわ}りの人{ひと}たちにどんなに反対{はんたい}されても、ぼく^はプロの歌手{かしゅ}になりたい。
examples.english: Even if everyone around me opposes it, I want to be a pro singer.
examples.note: たとえ + どんなに + ても.

examples.japanese: たとえ面倒{めんどう}でも、健康診断{けんこうしんだん}^は毎年{まいとし}受{う}けたほうがいいですよ。
examples.english: Even if it's a hassle, you should get a checkup every year.

more_examples.japanese: たとえ高{たか}くても、仕事{しごと}に必要{ひつよう}なもの^は買{か}わなければならない。
more_examples.english: Even if it's expensive, I must buy what I need for work.

patterns.book_explanation: 「～が事実だと仮定した場合でも、それに関係なく…。」
patterns.one_line_memory_trick: たとえ = 'Even in the worst case — still!'

patterns.reading: ば / たら / なら (反事実)
patterns.meaning: If ~ had been the case, … (but in reality it wasn't)

formation.form: ば形 / なければ / た形 + ら (often ～ていたら)
formation.example: あれば・寝坊していたら

formation.form: ～ければ / ～くなければ / ～かったら
Noun + なら / でなければ / だったら

patterns.connection_notes: Verbs are often ～ていたら. The second half often ends with ～た・～のだが・～のに.
cannot_be_used_for: Real future conditions (this usage is unreal)
patterns.exam_pinpoint: Sentence ends with ～のに / ～のだが / ～た + the fact is the opposite (残念だ・よかった) → counterfactual ば/たら/なら

confusable_with.difference: ばよかった directly expresses regret about one's own action.
confusable_with.how_to_choose: Fixed regret 'should have' → ばよかった.

common_traps: Second half in plain future (that's a real condition, not counterfactual)

examples.japanese: お金{かね}とひまがあれ^ばわたしも海外旅行{かいがいりょこう}するんだけど……。
examples.english: If I had money and time, I'd travel abroad too, but…
examples.note: Not true in reality → ～んだけど.

examples.japanese: ああ、残念{ざんねん}だ。学生{がくせい}なら学生割引{がくせいわりびき}でチケットが買{か}えたのに……。
examples.english: Ah, too bad. If I were a student, I could have bought a discounted ticket…

more_examples.japanese: もし寝坊{ねぼう}していたらこの飛行機{ひこうき}に^は乗{の}れなかった。間{ま}に合{あ}ってよかった。
more_examples.english: If I had overslept I couldn't have caught this flight. Glad I made it.

patterns.book_explanation: 「もし～の場合、…という結果になるはずだが、実際にはそうではない。」Both ～ and … differ from reality; … often ends in ～た・～のだが・～のに.
